description: Crown prosecutors are withdrawing all 14 murder charges laid against an Ontario man accused of selling a toxic substance to people at risk of self-harm, according to his lawyer. In turn, Kenneth Law will plead guilty to counselling or aiding suicide, Matthew Gourlay told CBC News on Friday evening.
title: Murder charges to be withdrawn against alleged poison seller Kenneth Law, lawyer says

description: U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick on Friday criticized the current iteration of North America's free trade agreement as a bad deal, taking a swipe at Canada's trade strategy ahead of upcoming negotiations.
title: U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick takes a swipe at Canada's trade strategy ahead of review

description: The Prince George Cougars failed to provide adequate security during a chaotic game against the Penticton Vees, Western Hockey League officials say.
title: Prince George Cougars fined $1,500 after rowdy crowd disrupts game, throws beer onto ice

description: A baby is dead and a toddler is still missing after they were unable to be rescued from a house that caught fire in Brazeau County, police said.
title: Baby dead, toddler missing after house fire in Brazeau County: RCMP

description: CBC Sports' daily newsletter gets you ready for all eight matchups in the opening round of the NHL playoffs, featuring three Canadian teams.
title: Stanley Cup playoffs primer: What to know for each first-round series

description: Braden Peters, also known as Clavicular online, was recently hospitalized after a suspected overdose. The 20-year-old influencer’s content, based around ‘looksmaxxing’ tips, has garnered attention for how extreme and dangerous it can be.
title: Has looksmaxxing guru Clavicular gone too far?

description: On Nov. 30, 2023, Dean Penney told a fictitious crime boss of his involvement in the death of his estranged wife, Jennifer Hillier-Penney, exactly seven years prior — and the steps he took to hide her body.
title: 'She'll never be seen': Dean Penney tells involvement in estranged wife's death to fictitious crime boss

description: The ice cream — flavoured with cajun seasoning, butter and garlic and topped with an entire crawfish — sounds like a novelty treat. But in the seven years this Texas shop has been serving it up, it's become a staple.
title: Crawfish ice cream has become this Texas shop's No. 1 menu item

description: Caylan Ford is hoping a Calgary courtroom will deliver her justice seven years after her private Facebook messages were leaked to media outlets, a move she says branded her a white supremacist and devastated her life.
title: Ex-UCP candidate who says she was branded a racist hopes 'truth can be aired in full' at trial

description: This video has been posted online with false claims that it shows the U.S. naval blockade of Iran. In fact, it's an old video — posted as early as May 2022.
title: Fact check: Old video does not show U.S. naval blockade of Iran

description: Safety issue impacts some vehicles with six-speed automatic transmissions made between 2015 and 2017. The issue can cause unexpected downshifting while the vehicle is moving.
title: Ford recalls 144,000 F-150s in Canada due to gearshift issue

description: A new book from Jacob Tierney promises an inside look at how Heated Rivalry became a global television phenomenon — packed with scripts, insights and behind-the-scenes moments.
title: Heated Rivalry showrunner Jacob Tierney to release behind-the-scenes book

description: Senior executives from Lockheed Martin will be in Quebec on Tuesday to confirm that they plan to service Canada's F-35 aircraft at the L3Harris facilities in Mirabel that are currently used to maintain the CF-18 fleet.
title: Lockheed Martin officials coming to Canada to tout maintenance plan for F-35s

description: The historical fiction novel won in a 4-1 vote on the final day of the great Canadian book debate.
title: Tegan Quin wins Canada Reads 2026 championing The Cure for Drowning by Loghan Paylor

description: Sexual assault charges against a self-styled spiritual leader and his wife in the Edmonton area have been stayed.
title: Sexual assault charges stayed against Alberta spiritual leader, wife

description: Calls are growing for Keir Starmer to resign after it was revealed that Peter Mandelson, who was a close friend to the late convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, failed a security vetting process but was appointed as the U.K's ambassador to the U. S. anyway.
title: Calls grow for Starmer to resign, as the shadow of Epstein still looms large over 10 Downing St.

description: Alberta has mandated a goal to restore the Montana-Alberta intertie to full capacity, whenever reasonable, potentially providing some relief to a trade irritant cited by U.S. President Donald Trump’s top trade representative last year.
title: Alberta commits to restore power line with Montana to capacity, potentially easing trade tension

description: Todd Lyons, acting director of U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), is planning to depart at the end of next month. Lyons's boss Markwayne Mullin at the Department of Homeland Security says he hopes that the Trump administration can carry out deportations "in a more quiet way," after several deaths and a drumbeat of negative media coverage.
title: Acting ICE director to leave as controversies, funding questions continue to swirl around agency

description: The Liberal government's groceries benefit and GST top-up announced in January will begin landing in Canadians' bank accounts in June.
title: One-time GST top-up to land in Canadians' accounts in June, Grocery Benefit in July

description: S&P 500, Dow Jones and Nasdaq all climbed shortly after open, as stocks run toward the finish of a third straight week of big gains. Brent crude oil, the international standard, dropped to $89.13 US a barrel — still higher than the $70 before the Iran war, but lower than it has been in recent weeks.
title: North American stocks rally and oil tumbles 10% after Iran says Strait of Hormuz is open

description: Forge FC midfielder Kyle Bekker gathered recently with teammates to inform them about his recent absence from the Canadian Premier League club. "I had surgery four weeks ago [this past] Monday to remove a tumour after being diagnosed with testicular cancer," Bekker revealed Thursday to CBC Sports.
title: After testicular cancer surgery, Forge FC's Kyle Bekker wants men to 'listen to their body'

description: The provincial government has purchased a pre-owned private jet for $28.9 million to be used by Ontario Premier Doug Ford.
title: Ontario government buys $28.9M private jet for Doug Ford's use
EMS head, pathologist to testify at inquest for Indigenous woman who died of sepsis in Ontario hospital

description: A B.C. developer who has already risked jail time for failing to come clean about the finances behind her lavish lifestyle now faces a possible bankruptcy order over a $74-million loan she guaranteed in relation to prime property in the heart of Vancouver's Cambie Corridor.
title: Bankruptcy bid adds to financial woes threatening debt-ridden B.C. developer
Exclusive: Carney's pitch to unlock trillions in global investment

description: Police say something "went wrong" when a youth managed to get a gun into a cell at the Thompson RCMP detachment after a search failed to find it on him. The incident happened in 2024. Cleaning staff found the gun behind a toilet two days later, and ammunition was later found in the toilet bowl.
title: RCMP failed to find gun during search of youth placed in Thompson, Man.,  detachment cell

description: An unusually large troop of chimpanzees displayed cooperation and social cohesion for decades, until something shifted and they started to turn on each other.
title: A chimpanzee 'civil war' erupted in Uganda. Scientists aren't sure why

description: A long-standing Toronto business has made the difficult decision to close its doors. The Patrician Grill, located on King Street East, was built in the 1950s and has been a family-owned restaurant since 1967. The cozy diner has been serving authentic homemade food to the business crowd, George Brown students and local residents for decades.
title: After more than 70 years, a beloved Toronto diner is closing its doors

description: Several workers for a Canadian-owned Mexican gold mine received no response after making complaints to the company’s workplace ethics hotline saying that local management was working with a prominent organized crime group to force out the existing union, according to two forme
title: Canadian firm ignored worker complaints over drug cartel-management links at Mexican gold mine, sources say

description: Two Hamilton teens are wondering why the city's plan to build one much needed basketball court in Gage Park is going to take 25 years.
title: 'I will be 41': Teens wonder why it's going to take Hamilton 25 years to build a basketball court

description: In Montreal, a young woman in a Spin magazine T-shirt stares furiously at the blank page on her 2011 MacBook. It's a moment from the new movie Mile End Kicks that could have been ripped from director Chandler Levack's own life, when the former critic traded Toronto for Montreal's exploding music scene. Mile End Kicks is one of two movies from Levack opening on Friday.
title: 'It's like I gave birth to twins': Canadian director Chandler Levack has 2 movies opening on the same day

description: Captain Antoine Forest, who died in a plane crash at New York's LaGuardia airport last month, will be remembered later today in his hometown of Coteau-du-Lac, Que.
title: Quebec pilot killed in crash at N.Y. airport to be remembered at visitation today

description: Lee Cronin's The Mummy, a needlessly mean-spirited horror flick that's barely about mummies, may have you asking a million questions. And before you even get to the plot-related ones, the most obvious is: what's with that title?
title: Why is Lee Cronin's The Mummy called that? Also, why is it so terrible?
